== Notes ==
* Reverse Hex is one of the few [[List of hex removal skills|hex removal skills]] that have an [[activation time]] of {{1/4}} second, so this skill can be cast during the [[aftercast delay]] between a hex and its [[cover]] hex, removing it before it is covered.

== Trivia ==
